hints.title: Digit Separation
hints.text: Extract all individual decimal digits from the given positive integer.

hints.title: Top Two Digits Selection
hints.text: Sort the digits in ascending order to isolate the two largest values.

hints.title: Product Calculation
hints.text: Multiply the two highest digits together.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: D: number of digits in integer n
complexity.notes: Sorting decimal digits isolates the two largest values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairwise combinations is unnecessary when sorting the digits suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Auxiliary string stores the short digit sequence.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Extract digits and return the product of the two largest values.
